name: tracker-adapter-polling
goal: Prove Tracker 122e190 adapter polling over an injected exclusive lease, including restart, retry, watermark and atomic journal receipts with synthetic GitHub data.

evidence: Preserve adapter_runner, adapter_sources, adapter_links and adapter_events compatibility. Assert lease contention and release, poll-start cursor and overlap, retries after atomic rollback, close/reopen mapping, and pending write-back until confirmed.
